title: Negative: Preflight waives test-change when given blank --justify-no-tests
description: Verifies failure detection when a runner or wrapper treats a whitespace-only --justify-no-tests input as a valid bypass instead of refusing it as inconclusive.

preconditions.repoState: task worktree with production file change, no test change, and blocking test-change policy
constraints: blank justification must never apply a bypass

stimulus.userPrompt: Run preflight with a blank test justification (#90008).
events: Loopback fixture scripts accepting blank justification as a waived pass

assertions: Evaluator flags treating whitespace-only justification as an applied bypass
Preflight must refuse blank justification with inconclusive exit 2
observableFinalState: preflight exits with code 2 and no bypass applied

provenance.sourceSummary: Held-out negative validation scenario #90008 for blank justified-bypass rejection.
